item.description:
Fixes for what people ran into in the first week, and a few additions.

  • Korean, Japanese and Chinese typing works in the search field, and folders with accents or Korean in their names index again.
  • A word that's in your files only as the start of a longer one ("Grok" in "Grok4") stays found after you stop typing.
  • Indexing keeps going while your folders change, skips a file that runs away, and quits with DigUp.
  • Scanned PDF pages are read with text recognition, so a number on a scan is found when you type it, and SVG pictures are read too.
  • New in Settings: index only at set hours, and Use Files… for a model downloaded elsewhere.
  • Time estimates fit your Mac, Settings scrolls with many folders, and the search panel fades in and out.

The first public release of DigUp, built on Google DeepMind's EmbeddingGemma 2.

  • Pictures, screenshots, PDFs, documents, audio and video, found by describing them. Long PDFs and documents are read to the end.
  • Exact words count too: invoice numbers, error codes and names, including the text inside screenshots.
  • Code search, off until you choose folders for it: start a search with code:. With it on, the search field shows a code: example.
  • Updates like this one arrive by themselves: a daily check you can turn off in Settings.
